stimulus.question: Checkout is reported to show elevated errors in the OTel Demo. Using the authorized metrics range query and trace search for the last 5 minutes, determine whether checkout and its dependency calls (payment, product-catalog, cart, currency, shipping, email) show failures or elevated latency, cite trace ids, and return a json investigation report.

claims.text: In the hour ending 2026-11-03T19:13:19Z, checkout span oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder had 57.96608532031489 STATUS_CODE_ERROR spans and 42.711852341284654 STATUS_CODE_UNSET spans, and payment span grpc.oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge had the identical values (57.96608532031489 ERROR / 42.711852341284654 UNSET). These are span counts, not request counts, and UNSET does not mean success.

Near the alert instant checkout PlaceOrder errors arrive in bursts on a very small sample: the 5-minute increase of STATUS_CODE_ERROR spans was 0 at epoch 1793733112 (2026-11-03T19:11:52Z) and 1.25 at epoch 1793733172, against 10 and 8.75 STATUS_CODE_UNSET spans at the same timestamps. This does not reproduce the annotation of 100% errors over the last 5 minutes.

The failing payment span (service payment, service_version 2.0.2, operation grpc.oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge, span_id 980f03b09e485074, trace_id 4caa75b6ab926948156511cb5ac4ed6c) carries otel.status_code=ERROR with grpc.error_name=Error, grpc.error_message 'Payment request failed. Invalid token. app.loyalty.level=gold', an identical exception.message, and exception.stacktrace 'Error: Payment request failed. Invalid token. app.loyalty.level=gold at module.exports.charge (/usr/src/app/charge.js:37:13) at ... Object.chargeServiceHandler [as charge] (/usr/src/app/index.js:21:22)'.

In trace 9b44c789873aff00d38d21a53403f4f0 the frontend client span grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder is ERROR with rpc.grpc.status_code=13 and grpc.error_message '13 INTERNAL: failed to charge card: could not charge the card: rpc error: code = Unknown desc = Payment request failed. Invalid token. app.loyalty.level=gold'; in the same trace the frontend POST /api/checkout span and the frontend-proxy ingress and 'router frontend egress' spans report http.status_code 500.

checkout's gRPC client metrics show non-zero status codes only for rpc_method Charge (rpc_grpc_status_code 2, rising to about 15.555584362193262 per 10-minute increase); Charge with code 0, Convert, EmptyCart, GetCart, GetProduct, GetQuote and ShipOrder are all rpc_grpc_status_code 0, and the remaining non-zero-labelled series EmptyCart code 9 is flat at 0.

Error-status spans over 15 minutes appear only on the checkout-to-payment path and its callers: checkout oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder, checkout client oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge, payment grpc.oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge, frontend POST and 'executing api route (pages) /api/checkout' and frontend client grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder, frontend-proxy ingress and 'router frontend egress', and load-generator POST; error series for cart, currency, product-catalog, shipping, email, fraud-detection and checkout's other operations are 0 in the same view.

24-hour baseline for payment grpc.oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge one-hour error increase: 0 in most hourly points with bursts of 9.152544958346033 (2026-11-03T01:13:19Z), 38.63888320070048 (13:13:19Z), 52.8838507353313 (16:13:19Z), 9.004765021490538 (17:13:19Z), 3.050334760118003 (18:13:19Z) and 57.96608532031489 (19:13:19Z); the current burst is the largest in 24h but this failure mode had already occurred earlier in the day.

checkout PlaceOrder's own 24-hour hourly error series follows the same bursty pattern (2.0340982672872925 at 18:13:19Z, 52.8838507353313 at 16:13:19Z, 57.96608532031489 at 19:13:19Z) and matches the payment Charge series at most points, though not identically at every point.

payment's visible spans are limited to grpc.oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge (ERROR and UNSET), an internal 'charge' span (UNSET only) and grpc.flagd.evaluation.v1.Service/ResolveFloat (UNSET only); no other payment operation has an ERROR series in the view.

The failing payment spans fail fast rather than slowly: sampled ERROR Charge spans lasted 19246 us and 9000 us, their child 'charge' spans 17219 us and 1644 us, and the flagd ResolveFloat call inside the same failing trace returned rpc.grpc.status_code 0. This argues against payment saturation, timeouts or flagd unavailability as the failure mechanism.

Checked and not failing in the same windows: checkout's other dependencies show no error spans (cart, currency, product-catalog, shipping operations are 0 ERROR in the 15-minute error-by-service view) and all their client gRPC calls returned status code 0; checkout itself fails only on PlaceOrder and its Charge client span.

Primary explanation: payment's Charge handler throws an application-level error at /usr/src/app/charge.js:37 ('Payment request failed. Invalid token. app.loyalty.level=gold'), which checkout surfaces as gRPC INTERNAL 13 and frontend returns as HTTP 500. Because a flagd ResolveFloat evaluation appears as a child of the failing Charge span and the message embeds a flag-evaluation context attribute (app.loyalty.level=gold), the most probable mechanism is the demo's payment failure-injection feature flag being active at a high percentage; that mechanism is inferred, not observed, because flag definitions are unavailable in this Run.

Alternative not excluded by the evidence: payment rejects specific incoming card/token values (the message literally says 'Invalid token'), i.e. deterministic validation of inputs produced by checkout or load-generator rather than flag-driven injection. Mixed successes and failures on the same edge fit either explanation, and the sampled spans carry no card-number or token attribute.

Rejected as this cause: payment unavailability, timeouts or gRPC deadline errors. The observed failing Charge calls return gRPC status 2 (UNKNOWN) at checkout's client and status 13 (INTERNAL) at checkout's caller within 9-19 ms, and payment's flagd calls succeed; no DEADLINE_EXCEEDED or UNAVAILABLE status series appears for Charge.
